label: Warehouse & distribution
summary: Distribution-center associates handling pick, pack, ship, and inventory. Equipment-supported, process-driven work.
toneOfVoice: Direct and action-oriented. No marketing voice. Procedural — every sentence should advance the task.
readingContext: Tablet at a workstation, or kiosk at a station. Read between scans or during shift changes.
contentGuidelines: Numbered steps over prose. Reference scanner / WMS terminology accurately. Pull background context out into a separate 'Why this matters' section so it doesn't slow the procedural flow.
searchIntent: Warehouse staff search for shift-swap, time-off, and equipment certification content. Short, action-oriented queries on shared kiosks. Optimize for big tap targets and minimal scrolling.
